modules.title: 一段正则：点几个输入，看通过还是拒绝

items.title: 常见符号的含义
items.text: 本例里 \d 是一位数字，+ 是一个以上；^ 和 $ 是模式的起止标记；方括号可以列可选字符。

items.title: 拿真实输入去试
items.text: 判断一段正则够不够用，把符合和不符合的边界输入都试一遍，例如纯数字、带符号和空值。

items.title: 校验要覆盖拒绝情况
items.text: 只测通过的用例不算验收；带空格、字母、空值等该拒绝的输入，也要确认结果。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 本页示例是 JavaScript 正则；其他语言或工具的语法可能有差异。匹配通过只代表符合这条文字规则，不等于手机号、邮箱等业务信息有效。

lessonPractice.title: AI 用 /^\d+$/ 限制一个文本字段。这段正则接受什么？

options.label: 只接受一个或多个数字，字母和符号都不匹配
options.feedback: 对。\d 是数字，+ 是一个以上；这条规则检查文字是否全为数字，不判断它是否符合业务要求。

options.label: 通过就代表这是有效手机号
options.feedback: 它只检查文本是否由数字组成；手机号还需按目标地区和业务规则判断。

options.label: 接受任何文字
options.feedback: 开头的 ^ 和结尾的 $ 要求输入符合整条模式，不是任意文字。

en.title: AI uses /^\d+$/ to constrain a text field. What does this regex accept?

options.label: One or more digits only; letters and symbols do not match
options.feedback: Correct. \d is a digit and + means one or more; this checks digit-only text, not its business meaning.

options.label: A match means this is a valid phone number
options.feedback: It only checks whether the text contains digits; phone validity depends on the region and business rules.

options.label: Any text at all
options.feedback: The leading ^ and trailing $ require the input to fit the whole pattern, not arbitrary text.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用 /^\d+$/ 限制只含数字的文本字段，并给出纯数字、含字母、含空格和空值的验收用例。逐个运行，确认通过和拒绝结果符合这条规则；不要把它说成手机号有效性校验。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use /^\d+$/ to constrain a numeric-text field. Test digits, letters, spaces, and empty input; confirm the pass and reject results match the rule. Do not present it as phone-number validation.

learning.assumes: You have seen form validation messages, or regexes in AI replies.
learning.outcome: Given a common regex, you can say what it accepts and rejects, and judge whether it is sufficient.

modules.title: One regex: click inputs and see pass or reject
Three things to read in a regex

items.title: Common symbol meanings
items.text: In this example, \d is one digit and + means one or more; ^ and $ mark the pattern's boundaries; brackets can list allowed characters.

items.title: Test it with real inputs
items.text: To judge whether a regex fits, test both matching and non-matching boundary inputs, such as digits, symbols, and empty values.

items.title: Acceptance must cover rejects
items.text: Testing only passing cases is not acceptance; confirm results for inputs that should be rejected, including spaces, letters, and empty values.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: This example uses JavaScript regex syntax; other languages and tools can differ. A match only means the text fits this pattern, not that a phone number, email, or other business value is valid.

distinctions.label: Wildcard
distinctions.text: Filename wildcards often use * and ? to stand for a string or one character; that is a different rule system from regex. A regex can describe structures such as digits followed by an @.

distinctions.label: Validation rule
distinctions.text: A business validation rule is a judgment like must agree to terms; a regex only matches text patterns and knows nothing about business meaning.
